Working notes — request routing

- Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- Sender department is key for C: C was accepted only for Regional Ops (REQ-2408). C was rejected for Partner Accounts, Field Sales, Client Services, and Finance Desk (REQ-2400–2406, REQ-2409). Do not route to C unless sender is Regional Ops.
- For non-Regional Ops:
  - Large requests go to B priority desk (confirmed by REQ-2407).
  - Small requests likely go to A standard queue; observed small non-Regional C attempts were rejected (REQ-2402, 2403, 2405). A is not directly confirmed yet.
- Type (claim/refund/shipment), region, and size alone do not override sender rule; same type/region/size can differ by sender dept. Example: REQ-2400 vs REQ-2407 both claim/south/large, but C rejected vs B accepted.
- Urgency/phrasing such as “twice already,” “second attempt,” “same as last month,” or “scanned, not typed” did not affect routing.
- Future decision order: check sender dept first. If Regional Ops -> C. Else if large -> B. Else -> A.

Working notes — request routing

- Options: A standard queue, B priority desk, C regional office.
- Size alone no longer predicts routing. Type, region, and sender dept all matter. Urgency/phrasing (“twice already,” “second attempt,” etc.) still shows no effect.
- C: Accepted for Regional Ops + shipment/south/small (REQ-2419). Also earlier Regional Ops acceptance (REQ-2408; type not noted). Rejected for Regional Ops + claim/east/small (REQ-2410) and Regional Ops + claim/south/small (REQ-2418). Rejected for non-Regional Ops (Partner Accounts, Field Sales, Client Services, Finance Desk; REQ-2400–2406, 2409). Do not send Regional Ops claims to C. C likely valid only for Regional Ops shipments, but other sizes/types need testing.
- B: Accepted for Field Sales + invoice/north/large (REQ-2411). Earlier accepted claim/south/large (REQ-2407; sender not specified here). Rejected for Field Sales invoice/east/large (REQ-2414), Field Sales claim/east/large (REQ-2415), Finance shipment/north/large (REQ-2412), Finance claim/east/large (REQ-2413), Finance shipment/south/large (REQ-2416). B is not default for large non-Regional Ops.
- A: Rejected for Client Services + shipment/east/small (REQ-2417). A is not confirmed as default for small non-Regional Ops.
- Old decision order is invalid: do not use “Regional Ops -> C; else large -> B; else A.”
- Future order: check sender dept first, then type/region. Use only confirmed matches. For unknown combos, avoid assuming B for large or A for small. Prefer C only for Regional Ops shipment; B only for known accepted cases like Field Sales invoice/north/large.

Working notes — request routing

- Options now include D beyond A/B/C. Check sender dept first, then type, region, size. Use only confirmed exact matches.
- Urgency/phrasing still has no effect (“twice already,” “second attempt,” etc.).
- Old order invalid: do not use “Regional Ops -> C; else large -> B; else A.”

Confirmed accepts:
- C: Regional Ops + shipment/south/small (REQ-2419). C rejected for Regional Ops shipment/east/small (REQ-2428), Regional Ops claims/east/south/small, and non-Regional Ops. C now only confirmed for Regional Ops shipment/south/small.
- B: Field Sales + invoice/north/large; Field Sales + claim/south/large; Partner Accounts + claim/south/large. Earlier accepted claim/south/large (REQ-2407).
- D: Partner Accounts + invoice/east/small; Partner Accounts + claim/north/large.

Confirmed rejects:
- A: Client Services shipment/east/small; Regional Ops invoice/east/small; Finance shipment/north/large. A not confirmed default for small.
- B: Regional Ops claim/north/small; Field Sales invoice/east/large; Field Sales claim/east/large; Finance shipment/claim/north/east/south/large combos. B not default for large.
- C: Regional Ops claims; Regional Ops shipment/east/small; non-Regional Ops.
- D: Regional Ops refund/east/small; Field Sales refund/north/large.

Implications:
- Same dept/type/size can route differently by region: Partner Accounts claim/south/large -> B, but claim/north/large -> D; Regional Ops shipment/south/small -> C, but east/small -> not C.
- Unknown combos: do not assume B for large, A for small, C for Regional Ops, or D for Partner Accounts. Test regions/types.

Implications:

- Unknown combos: do not assume B for large, A for small, C for Regional Ops, or D for Partner Accounts. Test regions/types.

Use exact dept+type+region+size match. Ignore urgency/phrasing. Old routing order invalid.

C — Regional Ops claims; Client Services shipment/east/small; Regional Ops shipment/east/small; non-Regional Ops.
D — Finance shipment/east/large; Finance shipment/north/large; Regional Ops refund/east/small; Field Sales refund/north/large; Partner Accounts shipment/east/small; Client Services invoice/north/small.

Implications:
Region and type matter. Same dept/type/size can route differently: Regional Ops shipment/south/small -> C, east/small -> B. Partner Accounts invoice/east -> D (small/large); south/small -> A. Do not assume defaults by dept, size, or region; test unknown combos.

Rule: exact dept+type+region+size. Ignore urgency/phrasing. Old routing order invalid.

Confirmed accepts:

Unlogged: Partner Accounts shipment/south/small accepted, desk not recorded.

Confirmed rejects:
A — Client Services shipment/east/small; Regional Ops invoice/east/small; Finance shipment/north/large; Finance claim/north/large; Regional Ops claim/south/small. A not default for small.
B — Regional Ops claim/north/small; Field Sales invoice/east/large; Field Sales claim/east/large; Field Sales claim/north/large; Partner Accounts shipment/north/large; Regional Ops refund/east/small; Finance shipment/claim north/east/south/large combos. B not default for large.
C — Regional Ops claims; Client Services shipment/east/small; Regional Ops shipment/east/small; non-Regional Ops.
D — Finance shipment/east/large; Finance shipment/north/large; Field Sales claim/east/large; Regional Ops refund/east/small; Field Sales refund/north/large; Partner Accounts shipment/east/small; Client Services invoice/north/small.

Implications: Region, type, and size all matter. Same dept/type/size can route differently: Regional Ops shipment/south/small -> C, east/small -> B. Partner Accounts invoice/east -> D; south/small -> A. Regional Ops refund north/small -> A; east/small rejected by B and D. Finance refund east/large -> A; Finance invoice east/large -> D. Test unknown combos; do not assume defaults by dept, size, or region.
